payload.core_mechanism_summary: 2D DP where dp[i][j] counts ways after processing first i chars of S, with built string A matching a length-i substring of T starting at index j. Transitions add next char to left (decrement j) or right.
payload.rationale: Solution uses a 2D DP array with states (i, j) representing the number of ways to have a string A of length i that matches T[j..j+i-1] after i operations. This matches dp_2d_state family.
